title: Your LinkedIn *CAN* Help Your Job Search
description:
LinkedIn's new feature is HUGE. When you upload your resume to LinkedIn, even if your profile isn't fully built out, your experience will still be searchable by recruiters. Maybe you don't want to update your profile because you don't want anyone from your current company to see it's been updated (probably a sign you're looking for something new)—this is the way to get all those important keywords in there and you'll show up much higher in the search. #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobsearching

transcript: you currently have a job but you're looking for a new one and you don't want your employer to know linkedin's new feature lets you upload your resume to your profile which whoopy do why should you care because your resume content is now included in the content that makes your LinkedIn profile searchable maybe you don't want to update your LinkedIn because you know your boss would notice and then you have to talk to them about it and that's just weird it's all good just make sure your resume is stacked with great content keywords and metric-based achievements then on LinkedIn go to settings data privacy down here to job application settings upload your resume then toggle on the option to share with all recruiters and you are good to go
